1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nc6 3.Nc3 Bc5 4.Qg4 Qf6 5..strategy: Springs the trap with a double attack on the queen and c7, while the queen on g4 still hits g7. Black can take f2 with check, but the king steps to d1 and White's threats against g7 and c7 outweigh the lost pawn.
